01.text:
In spring, the little rabbit
found a glowing dandelion seed
by the field path.
01.narration: In spring, the little rabbit found a glowing dandelion seed by the field path.

02.text:
The seed whispered
that it was a letter
from far away.
02.narration: The seed whispered that it was a letter from far away.

03.text:
The rabbit planted it
below the window and
watered it every day.
03.narration: The rabbit planted it below the window, watered it every day, and told it secrets.

04.text:
One early summer evening,
the dandelion bloomed
into a fluffy little lamp.
04.narration: One early summer evening, the dandelion bloomed into a fluffy little lamp.

05.text:
Then the wind came,
and the little seeds flew
into the sky like stars.
05.narration: Then the wind came, and the little seeds flew into the sky like stars.

06.text:
The rabbit ran after them,
all the way up
the little hill.
06.narration: The rabbit ran after them, all the way up the little hill.

07.text:
The best letter
brings light to more people.
07.narration: The best letter is the one that brings light to more people.

08.text:
The next spring, the whole
hillside lit up with
tiny dandelion lamps.
08.narration: The next spring, the whole hillside lit up with tiny dandelion lamps.
